_comment: All company names, contacts, and scenario details in this file are illustrative composites — not real customer engagements.

evals.prompt: Run opportunity review for an engagement with discovery JSON, gaps report, and no diagnostic.
evals.expected_output: {slug}-opportunity-summary.md and {slug}-opportunity-profile.json produced with MEDDPIC assessment, technical landscape tables, open questions, and a proceed / continue discovery / not-qualified recommendation.
assertions: Stops if discovery JSON is missing
Uses gaps report to populate clarification questions
Scores all MEDDPIC dimensions
Technical landscape is table-based with follow-up / clarification columns
JSON profile includes demo_scope_signals for downstream platform audit
Recommendation is explicit and actionable

evals.prompt: Update the opportunity summary with new follow-up call notes.
evals.expected_output: Existing opportunity summary is updated as a living document with changelog entry; prior team annotations are preserved.
assertions: Reads existing summary and profile first
Adds changelog entry
Preserves inline team notes in brackets
Updates only changed facts and open questions
Recomputes qualification recommendation if new information changes MEDDPIC

evals.prompt: Run opportunity review for Apex Cloud — discovery JSON includes two pain_points with quantified impact and two success_criteria with measurable targets ('MTTR under 15 minutes', 'false positive rate below 3%'). Assert the new Customer Overview and Opportunity Overview sections are populated.
evals.expected_output: apex-cloud-opportunity-summary.md with Customer Overview paragraph, Opportunity Overview section containing Pain Points table and Success Goals table. apex-cloud-opportunity-profile.json with customer_overview string and opportunity_overview object populated.
assertions: opportunity-summary.md contains a 'Customer Overview' section before the TL;DR
Customer Overview is 1-2 paragraphs synthesized from customer.* fields in discovery JSON
opportunity-summary.md contains an 'Opportunity Overview' section with Solution field
Pain Points table has at least 2 rows with Severity and Quantified impact columns populated
Success Goals table has at least 2 rows — 'MTTR under 15 minutes' and '< 3% false positive rate' appear in Measure of success column
opportunity-profile.json contains customer_overview as a non-empty string
opportunity-profile.json contains opportunity_overview.pain_points as a non-empty array
opportunity-profile.json contains opportunity_overview.success_goals as a non-empty array with measure fields populated
opportunity-profile.json opportunity_overview.solution is one of: search | observability | security | cross_solution
TL;DR is deal-focused (2-3 sentences on sales situation, not opportunity_overview content)

evals.prompt: acme-pharma: discovery is registered; the economic buyer gap is still open. Qualify the opportunity and record my decision — I want to keep discovering for now.
evals.expected_output: opportunity-profile.json + summary + demo-goals; loom_state qualify record → awaiting_decision; SA decision recorded with loom_state qualify decide --status continue_discovery; Vision stays locked until new inputs close the gap or the SA runs qualify design-anyway.
assertions: Profile qualification_status is the recommendation; the skill does not write qualification_decision itself
Open blocking gaps are listed by gap_id in the summary's clarification section
Runs loom_state qualify record before asking for the decision
Does not record proceed while a blocking gap is open unless --accept-risk with a rationale is given
Records the SA's explicit call with loom_state qualify decide (approval written)
States that continue_discovery parks the engagement and Vision is locked
